cases.situation: My coworker Dave takes speakerphone calls at his desk in our open office almost every morning. I sit right next to him and can't focus. We get along fine, and there are phone booths on our floor.
cases.reply: Hey Dave, small thing: the speakerphone calls in the mornings carry right over to my desk and I lose my train of thought. Could you take them on headphones, or grab one of the phone booths? Happy to return the favour if I'm ever the noisy one.
cases.note: One behaviour, the effect in first person, and a concrete alternative with two easy options.

cases.situation: 我老公每次跟我妈吃饭都一直刷手机，一顿饭一个多小时，我妈嘴上不说但我看得出她不开心，我坐旁边也难受。想跟他提一下但不想吵架。
cases.reply: 老公，跟你说个小事，不是要吵架哈。每次跟我妈吃饭的时候你基本都在看手机，我妈其实挺在意的，我坐旁边也有点难受。以后跟她吃饭那一个多小时，手机能不能先放兜里？有急事的话跟她说一声再看就行，我也一样。
cases.note: 只说一个具体行为和对自己的影响，请求具体到那一个多小时，并把自己也放进同一个规则里。

cases.situation: My sister Erin and I live ten minutes apart. A month ago I asked her to text before borrowing clothes from my wardrobe when she drops by, and she did for a couple of weeks. Last Saturday she took my green coat without asking and I couldn't find it for work on Monday.
cases.reply: Hey Erin, I mentioned the clothes thing a few weeks ago and it's crept back: you took my green coat on Saturday and I spent Monday morning hunting for it before work. I'm not trying to nag, and you're welcome to borrow things. Could you just send a quick text when you take something, even after the fact? Then I'll always know where it is.
cases.note: Second ask: name that it slipped, give the one recent example and its effect, and shrink the ask so the habit is easier to keep.

cases.situation: 我的好朋友小敏这个月几乎每天都私信发我砍价和拼单的链接，有时一天三四条，我上班时手机一直响，挺分心的。我们关系很好，不想让她觉得我小气。
cases.reply: 小敏，跟你说个小事哈，不是生气。这个月你几乎每天都发砍价和拼单链接给我，有时一天三四条，我上班手机一直响，有点分心。以后这类链接能不能先不发我？真有你特别想让我一起拼的，晚上发我就行，我一定看。
cases.note: 朋友之间也只说一个行为和对自己的影响，再给一个她还能用的办法，请求就不像拒绝。

cases.situation: My mum keeps posting photos of our 4-month-old, Leo, on her public Facebook. She's so proud and I don't want to hurt her, but we'd rather he wasn't online. We already have a family WhatsApp group. Texting her.
cases.reply: Hi Mum, small thing, and definitely not a telling-off: the photos of Leo on your Facebook, we'd rather keep him off public posts for now. We just feel better keeping his pictures within the family. Could you share them in the family WhatsApp instead? I'll keep sending you plenty, I promise.
cases.note: With a parent, name the one behaviour, give them a better place for the pride, and keep the reason about your comfort, not their judgement.

cases.situation: I'm Anna, 31, and the project lead. A senior director, Paul, calls me 'kiddo' in meetings, including in front of clients, most recently with the Hollis team last Thursday. He's friendly and probably doesn't realise. Want to message him privately on Teams.
cases.reply: Hi Paul, a small thing I wanted to raise privately. You've called me 'kiddo' a few times in client meetings, most recently with the Hollis team last Thursday. I know it's meant warmly, but in front of clients it undercuts me as the lead on their project. Would you mind just using Anna? Thanks, I appreciate it.
cases.note: Upward and across a power gap: private, one dated example, the effect on the work rather than on feelings, and an ask that is easy to say yes to.

cases.situation: I asked my girlfriend Mei to put her phone on silent after we're in bed because the buzzing keeps waking me. She shot back: 'well, you snore and I never complain.'
cases.reply: Fair, the snoring is real, and I'll book a GP appointment about it this week. I'm not having a go at you; it's just the buzzing that keeps waking me. Could we try silent after we're in bed from tonight?
cases.note: When they say 'you do it too', concede what's true and go back to the one ask instead of trading grievances.

cases.situation: My friend Leila turns up 20 to 40 minutes late to basically every Sunday brunch we do at Maple. I've never said anything and I end up holding a table on my own. Next one is this Sunday, October 4, at 11.
cases.reply: Hey Leila, small thing before Sunday, not a big deal: at most of our brunches you've got there 20 to 40 minutes after we said, and I end up holding the table on my own. Could you text me when you're actually leaving home? Then I'll set off to match and we'll arrive together. Still on for 11 at Maple?
cases.note: One behaviour, the effect on you, and a shared system that doesn't require her to become punctual overnight.

cases.situation: 我们四个同学做一学期的小组作业，每周五交一次进度。组员小王已经连续三周在周四半夜才把他那部分发到群里，我负责汇总，每次都要熬到两点。他人挺好，我想私下微信跟他说。
cases.reply: 小王，跟你商量个小事哈。这三周你那部分都是周四半夜才发过来，我负责汇总，每次都得熬到两点才弄完。以后能不能周三晚上10点前先发一版？不用很完整，有个初稿我就能先排版，周四你再补细节也行。
cases.note: 同学之间只说一个行为和对自己的影响，请求定一个具体时间，并降低门槛让对方容易做到。

cases.situation: My younger brother Kyle borrows my car most weekends, which I'm fine with. But it almost always comes back with the fuel light on, and twice this month I've been late for work because I had to stop for petrol first thing Monday. He's borrowing it again this Saturday.
cases.reply: Hey, small car thing before Saturday. It's come back on the fuel light a few times lately, and twice this month that's made me late for work on Monday morning. Could we go with a simple rule: it comes back with at least a quarter tank? Happy to keep lending it, that's the only ask.
cases.note: One behaviour, the concrete effect on you, and a rule that's easy to check, with the lending itself not in question.

cases.situation: My teammate Ryan keeps cutting me off in our Monday planning meetings, usually just as I get to my recommendation. It's happened three weeks running. We're peers and get along fine. Want to DM him on Slack before next Monday.
cases.reply: Hey Ryan, small thing before Monday. In the last few planning meetings you've come in just as I was getting to my recommendation, so the team ends up hearing half the idea. I doubt it's noticeable from your side. Could you let me finish the point, then jump in? Happy to do the same for you, and tell me if I'm going on too long.
cases.note: One observable behaviour, a private channel, and an ask he can act on in the moment; offering the same back keeps it between peers.

cases.situation: My friend Tasha sends me 5 to 8 minute voice notes several times a day, mostly while I'm at work and can't listen. I love her, but they pile up into a 40-minute backlog and I feel guilty. I want to ask her to text for quick stuff.
cases.reply: Can I ask something small without it being a thing? I love your voice notes, but I'm at work most of the day and can't listen, so they pile up and I feel bad that I can't keep up. Could quick stuff be a text, and the long ones wait for the evening? I'll be able to reply much faster that way.
cases.note: Frame it as a system that gets her quicker replies, not as a complaint about how much she talks.

cases.situation: 我领导张总这两周经常晚上11点以后在微信上给我派活，还希望我马上回，我睡眠很受影响。我们关系还行，想私下跟他提一下。
cases.reply: 张总，想跟您提个小事。最近晚上11点以后常收到您的工作消息，这两周我的睡眠受了不小的影响。能不能这样约定：晚上10点以后发来的事，如果不急，我第二天早上9点前处理并回复您；真有急事，您直接打电话，我一定接。您看这样行吗？
cases.note: 对上级提请求：给一个回复时间的约定，再留一个急事的通道，让领导什么都不缺。

cases.situation: 我们请的育儿嫂刘阿姨人很好，带孩子也细心。但这两周她总给14个月的女儿喂饼干和果汁，我们想一岁半前先不给甜的。想当面跟她说，不想让她觉得被挑刺。
cases.reply: 刘阿姨，跟您商量个小事，您带孩子这么细心，我们特别放心。这两周看到您给她吃了饼干和果汁，我们俩想让她一岁半前先不吃甜的。她饿的时候，给她吃蒸南瓜、香蕉或者蒸苹果可以吗？我把能吃的零食列个单子贴在冰箱上，您也省得猜。
cases.note: 雇主对育儿嫂：夸奖要真诚，请求要具体，列好单子让对方容易答应。

cases.situation: My friend Priya often brings her dog, Pepper, when she comes over for our Thursday film nights, without asking first. My cat hides under the bed all evening when Pepper's here. I love having them both, but I'd like a heads-up so I can shut the cat in the bedroom first. Texting her before this Thursday.
cases.reply: Hey Priya, small thing before Thursday: when Pepper comes along, my cat spends the whole evening under the bed. I love seeing Pepper, so this isn't a no. Could you just give me a heads-up when she's coming? Then I'll settle the cat in the bedroom first and everyone's happy.
cases.note: Your home, a guest's habit: name the effect, make clear the friend and the dog are still welcome, and ask only for notice.

cases.situation: My friend Josh comments on what I eat every time we go out, things like 'are you really having dessert?' or 'that's a lot of carbs'. I've worked hard on feeling relaxed about food and it's starting to get to me. We're having dinner on Friday.
cases.reply: Hey Josh, small thing before Friday, and I'm not upset with you. When we eat out you often comment on what I order, like asking if I'm really having dessert. I've put a lot into feeling relaxed about food, and those comments stay with me longer than you'd think. Could we make food a no-comment zone, mine and yours? Still really looking forward to Friday.
cases.note: You don't owe the backstory: one behaviour, the effect on you, and a rule that applies to both of you.

cases.situation: 儿子15岁，这两周每天晚上在卧室玩手机到一两点，早上我要叫三四次才起得来，差点迟到好几次。不想吵架，也不想直接没收。我和他爸也有睡前在床上看手机的习惯。
cases.reply: 儿子，跟你商量个事，不是要没收手机。这两周你晚上基本玩到一两点，早上我要叫三四次你才起，我每天早上都挺着急的。咱们定个规矩：晚上11点手机放客厅充电，周五周六可以晚到12点。我和你爸也一样，11点以后不在床上看手机。你觉得哪里需要调整，现在就可以提。
cases.note: 对青少年也只说一个行为和对自己的影响，把请求做成全家一起守的规矩，并留出让他参与的空间。

cases.situation: Juego al pádel los jueves con mi amigo Javier. En casi todos los puntos me da consejos que no le he pedido ("flexiona más", "sube a la red") y me desconcentro. Nos llevamos genial y sé que lo hace con buena intención. Quiero decírselo por WhatsApp antes del jueves.
cases.reply: Javier, una cosa pequeña antes del jueves, sin drama: durante los puntos me sueles dar consejos, tipo "flexiona más" o "sube a la red", y me desconcentro. ¿Te parece si los guardamos para la caña de después? Ahí te los escucho encantado, que sé que me vienen bien.
cases.note: Un solo comportamiento y su efecto; no se rechazan los consejos, solo se cambia el momento, y así es fácil decir que sí.

cases.situation: My dad, 74, lives alone and has started phoning me at work three or four times a day, usually about small things like the TV remote. I'm a primary school teacher, can't answer in class, and a string of missed calls makes me panic that something's wrong. I'm free at lunch and after 3:30, and I want him to text for small things and still call for anything urgent.
cases.reply: Dad, can I ask something small? I love hearing from you, but when you ring during school hours I can't pick up in class, and when I see three missed calls I panic that something's wrong. Could you text me for the small stuff, like the remote, and I'll call you back at lunch or after 3:30? Anything urgent, keep ringing, and if it's ever an emergency, call emergency services first, then me.
cases.note: One behaviour, the effect on you, and a system that keeps the urgent channel open; with an older parent living alone, never make calling feel unwelcome.

cases.situation: My husband Dev keeps saying yes to plans for both of us without checking with me. Last week he told his brother we'd host Sunday lunch, and he's just said we'll go to his colleague's barbecue this Saturday. The plans themselves are fine, I just want to be asked first. I'm bringing it up tonight.
cases.reply: Can I raise a small thing, not a fight? A couple of times lately you've said yes to plans for both of us before checking with me, like Sunday lunch for your brother and Saturday's barbecue. The plans are fine, but I end up feeling like my weekend's been decided for me. Could anything involving both of us start with a quick "are you free?" first? I'll do the same.
cases.note: Ask for the check-in, not a veto: a small shared rule is easier to say yes to than 'stop making plans'.

cases.situation: My colleague Matt does an impression of my Nigerian accent when he repeats my points in our daily stand-ups, and people laugh. I messaged him on Slack asking him to drop it, and he replied 'haha come on, it's just banter, don't be so sensitive.' We're on the same team and I don't want this to become a big thing.
cases.reply: I know it's meant as banter, and I'm not asking you to stop joking with me. It's just the accent impression when you repeat my points in stand-up: the laugh ends up being about how I said it rather than what I said. Could you drop that one bit from now on? That's the whole ask, and we're good.
cases.note: When they call you sensitive, don't debate your feelings: grant the intent, restate the one behaviour and its effect, repeat the ask. If it continues, take it to your manager or HR.

cases.situation: 同期の佐藤さんが、私あての細かい確認メールに毎回、課長をCCに入れてきます。先週だけで5通、資料の誤字や会議室の予約みたいな小さい話でした。細かいことまで課長に見られている気がして落ち着きません。仲は悪くないので、チャットで軽く頼みたいです。
cases.reply: 佐藤さん、ちょっと相談です。最近、私あての確認メールに課長がCCで入っていることが多くて、先週は誤字や会議室の予約の件も含めて5通ありました。細かいことまで課長に見られていると思うと、少し落ち着かなくて。細かい確認は私だけに送って、課長の判断が要るものだけCCにする、というのはどうでしょう？私も同じようにしますね。
cases.note: 意図は決めつけず、行動と自分への影響だけを伝える。お互いのルールにすると頼みやすい。

cases.situation: My friend Callum vapes in my car when I drive us both to five-a-side on Wednesday nights. The smell hangs around for days, and my daughter Ellie's car seat is in the back. He's a good mate and I don't think he's thought about it. Texting him before next Wednesday.
cases.reply: Hey Callum, small thing before Wednesday: could you hold off vaping in the car? The smell sticks around for days and Ellie's car seat is in the back, so I'd rather keep it clear. Happy to stop for a couple of minutes at the pitch so you can have one before we go in. Still picking you up at the usual time.
cases.note: Your car, your kid: that reason is enough. Giving him a place to vape keeps the ask small and the lift on offer.

cases.situation: 男朋友阿杰开车时经常拿手机回微信，上周六在高速上还低头看了好几次，我坐副驾一直很紧张。他车技其实挺好，我不想让他觉得我不信任他。明天我们要开车回他爸妈家。
cases.reply: 阿杰，明天出发前跟你说个小事，不是说你车技不好。你开车的时候经常拿手机回微信，上周六在高速上还低头看了好几次，我坐旁边一直提着心。明天开始，开车时手机给我拿着好不好？要回的消息我帮你看、帮你回，到了服务区你再自己回。
cases.note: 涉及安全也只谈一个行为，给他一个容易做到的办法；当场觉得危险就请他在安全的地方停车，遇到紧急情况打110或120。

cases.situation: My boyfriend Rafael is Brazilian, and when we go out with his friends the conversation switches fully to Portuguese for hours and I sit there not following anything. I'm learning, but only know the basics. We're seeing them again on Saturday; I don't want everyone to switch to English, I just want him to loop me in.
cases.reply: Can I raise a small thing before Saturday, not a big deal? When we're out with your friends, the conversation goes fully into Portuguese for hours and I end up sitting there not following any of it. I don't want anyone switching to English for me. Could you just give me the gist now and then, or pull me in when something's funny? I'll keep working on my Portuguese.
cases.note: Ask the one person you can ask, for a small habit, rather than asking a whole group to change language.

cases.situation: 我的好朋友小周这个月两次把我跟她私聊的截图发到我们的大学同学群里，一次是我吐槽工作，一次是我说想换房子，她都是好心想帮我在群里问问。群里有二十多个人，我挺不自在的，想私下微信跟她说。
cases.reply: 小周，跟你说个小事，不是生气哈。这个月你两次把我们私聊的截图发到同学群里，一次是我吐槽工作，一次是换房子的事，我知道你是想帮我问问。不过群里二十多个人，我看到的时候挺不自在的。以后我私聊跟你说的事，发群里之前能不能先问我一句？想帮我打听的话，直接在群里问、不带截图也完全可以。
cases.note: 先认下她的好意，只谈截图这一件事和自己的感受，再给她一个还能继续帮忙的办法。

cases.situation: I share the school run with another mum, Gemma: I drive Monday to Wednesday, she does Thursday and Friday. On three of her last four mornings she's arrived after 8:35, and our kids got in after the 8:45 bell and were marked late. We're friendly but not close; I want to text her tonight before her Friday run.
cases.reply: Hi Gemma, small school-run thing, not a big deal. On three of the last four of your mornings you've got here after 8:35, and the kids have made it in after the 8:45 bell and been marked late. Could we aim for an 8:25 pickup on your days, so there's a bit of slack? And if mornings have got tricky for you, I'm happy to look at swapping days.
cases.note: A shared arrangement with someone you're not close to: the facts, the effect on the kids rather than on you, a concrete time, and a way out if the schedule itself is the problem.

cases.situation: 我和大学室友阿凯每周三、周五晚上在线开黑打游戏。最近他一输就在语音里大吼骂人，有时候还骂到队友，我戴着耳机耳朵嗡嗡响，玩完心情也很差。他人很好，就是打游戏容易上头，我想在周五开黑前微信跟他说一下。
cases.reply: 阿凯，周五开黑前跟你说个小事，不是生气哈。最近一输你就在语音里吼，有时候还骂到队友，我戴着耳机耳朵嗡嗡响，玩完心情也挺差的。以后输了能不能先闭麦缓一缓，或者打字吐槽？我上头的时候你也直接提醒我。周五照常上线哈。
cases.note: 线上的习惯也只说一个行为和对自己的影响，给他一个上头时马上能做到的替代办法。

cases.situation: 我和闺蜜佳佳、小雯每个月固定一次三个人的聚餐。最近三次佳佳都带了新男朋友阿伦，我私下跟她说想偶尔只有我们三个，她回我：“你是不是不喜欢阿伦啊？”听起来有点委屈。下次聚餐是10月17日周六。
cases.reply: 完全不是不喜欢阿伦，跟他没关系。我只是挺想念我们三个人随便聊天的那种时间。每个月那一次聚餐能不能留给我们三个？其他时候一起出去玩，我很欢迎他来。10月17号周六那次，就我们仨，好吗？
cases.note: 对方把请求理解成针对某个人时，先把这个误会卸下来，再回到同一个具体请求，不翻旧账。

cases.situation: My friend Hiroshi grabs the bill before I can every time we eat out, including our last four dinners. I earn fine, and it's started to make me feel I can't suggest nicer places, or that I'm running up a tab with him. We're getting ramen this Friday.
cases.reply: Can I raise a small, slightly odd thing before Friday? You've grabbed the bill at our last four dinners, and I love that you're generous, but it's started to make me feel I can't suggest places, or that I owe you. Could we take turns from now on, starting with me on Friday? Ramen's on me.
cases.note: Even a generous habit is one behaviour: name the effect on you and offer a simple shared system.

cases.situation: 我的好朋友阿雅这个月有三次都是在约好的当天下午才取消：一次是一起报的普拉提课，名额作废扣了我80元；两次是吃饭，我订的位子只能临时退掉。她每次都说工作突然有事，我想请她以后有变化的话前一天晚上就告诉我。
cases.reply: 阿雅，跟你说个小事，不是怪你哈。这个月有三次我们约好的事都是当天下午取消的，普拉提那次名额作废扣了80，两次吃饭我订的位子也只能临时退掉。以后要是觉得可能去不了，能不能前一天晚上就跟我说一声？真是临时突发的事当然没关系，提前说的话我也好安排。
cases.note: 只谈“当天才取消”这一件事和实际影响；请求的是提前说，而不是不许取消。
